name: mala3by-whatsapp-connector
description: Persistent Node/TypeScript service that performs the real WhatsApp Multi-Device (Baileys) handshake and message delivery, behind a WhatsAppProvider adapter interface. Never runs inside the Vite client -- session credentials never leave this process. Talks to Supabase via narrow whatsapp_connector_* RPCs, never raw table access.

scripts.test: npm run test:templates && npm run test:send-reliability && npm run test:root-cause && npm run test:status-fencing && npm run test:auth-dir-cleanup && npm run test:delivery-receipts && npm run test:send-protocol-diagnostics
